summary: Iteration-3 full test of the new B2C layer (individual/marketer) on top of the existing B2B platform. BACKEND: 72 pytest tests run against the public preview URL (71 pass, 1 fails and documents a real money bug). Added 3 new suites: tests/test_b2c_individual.py (19 tests: smart registration office/individual, pricing stripping for individual+guest vs office, individual authorization 403s, become-marketer idempotency + affiliate link, individual wallet/topup, B2C booking math final*seats with platform_profit/marketer split verified per-booking in the platform_revenue collection, affiliate ref crediting, bad ref ignored, blue-cancel reversal, yellow-cancel blocked for individual, admin metrics), tests/test_b2c_money_safety.py (5 tests incl. the failing negative-wallet case), tests/test_escrow_conservation.py (2 tests proving B2B dispute refund_buyer and yellow cancel-accept are money-conserving; the pre-existing -1000 seller wallets in Mongo are stale artifacts from the pre-iteration-2 code, created 11:44/11:54, not reproducible now), tests/test_auth_playbook.py (5 tests: bcrypt $2b$ admin hash, HttpOnly+Secure+SameSite=None cookie, CORS allow-credentials with explicit origin (verified on 8001; preview ingress rewrites ACAO to *), brute-force lockout after 5 fails -> 429 (now WORKING, was failing in iteration 2), /auth/me token guard + no password_hash leak). FRONTEND: verified landing for guests (all 5 CTA testids) + ?ref= capture into localStorage meraaj_ref + logged-in redirect to /dashboard; smart registration for BOTH types (individual hides reg-office-name/reg-address/reg-license and shows reg-name; office requires license) with correct role-based sidebars; individual sees ONLY final price on /market and /market/:id (no net cost / no distributor commission) while office sees 'التكلفة الصافية 1,000' + 'عمولتك كموزّع 200'; individual B2C booking end-to-end (charged 1,300 = final*1, appears in حجوزاتي, wallet 8,820 -> 7,520); marketer activation -> affiliate link ?ref=CODE + earnings card (120.00 from 2x60 commissions); B2C blue cancellation via UI refunded 1,280 with the 60 marketer commission clawed back; individual blocked (redirected) from /packages, /packages/new, /sales and office blocked from /marketer; admin dashboard shows أرباح المنصة 8,672 / الأفراد 89 / المسوّقون 26; landing mobile 390px has no horizontal overflow.

critical.issue: MARKETER WALLET CAN GO NEGATIVE. The 20% marketer commission is credited to `available` immediately at booking time and is instantly spendable. If the marketer spends it and the buyer then cancels the blue booking, the reversal `adjust_wallet(marketer, available=-commission)` is applied with no balance check -> wallet went to {'total': -58, 'available': -58} in a reproducible test (tests/test_b2c_money_safety.py::test_marketer_wallet_goes_negative_after_spending_then_cancel, currently FAILING by design to document this). Fix: hold marketer commission in `pending` until the booking settles (green + grace), or clamp/record a negative-balance debt instead of allowing overdraft.

minor.issue: LEDGER MISMATCH: the marketer-commission reversal moves money out of the wallet but writes NO transactions row (only cancel_refund is logged). Reproduced on user1@qa-example.com: wallet available 8,740 while the sum of its transactions is 8,800 (delta = the un-logged -60 clawback). Add a `marketer_commission_reversal` txn (and mirror the platform_revenue reversal in the ledger).

SELF-REFERRAL: market.py lines 144-145 fall back to `user.affiliate_code` when no ref is supplied, so any individual who activates marketer mode earns 20% of the margin on their OWN purchases (verified: 1,300 charged, 60 credited back = permanent self-discount). Only the seller is excluded (m != seller). Confirm this is intended; otherwise exclude marketer_id == buyer_id.

The retained cancellation admin fee (2% of net) and the yellow-cancel platform_cut (10% of the deduction) are never written to platform_revenue nor to any wallet — money silently leaves the system totals and Target Media's reported profit understates actual take. Verified in tests/test_b2c_money_safety.py::test_admin_fee_on_b2c_cancel_is_not_recorded_anywhere.

Transfers are hard-filtered to role=='office' recipients, so an individual can never receive P2P money although the individual wallet UI exposes the 'تحويل P2P' button (it always 404s with 'المكتب المستلم غير موجود'). Either allow individual recipients or hide the button for individuals.
Carried over from iterations 1-2: the seats/balance check and the wallet debit are read-then-$inc (non-atomic); concurrent bookings can oversell seats or overdraw the available balance.
Carried over: visa_file is unconditionally overwritten with the payload value (None when omitted), wiping a previously stored visa file on re-submit.

4 stale seller accounts (test_dr_s_*, test_ddr_s_*, created 11:44/11:54 before the iteration-2 guards) still sit at wallet {'total': -1000, 'pending': -1000}. Current code is money-neutral for the same flows (tests/test_escrow_conservation.py passes), but these rows skew the admin 'إجمالي السيولة/المعلّق' figures.

ui_bugs.issue: `copy = () => { navigator.clipboard.writeText(data.link); ... }` has no await/try-catch. When clipboard permission is denied (or a non-secure/permission-less context) the rejected promise surfaces as a full-screen CRA red 'Uncaught runtime errors: Failed to execute writeText on Clipboard: Write permission denied' overlay covering the whole app, and a false 'تم نسخ رابط الإحالة' success toast is still shown. Wrap in try/catch with a textarea/execCommand fallback and only toast on success.

The 5 load() API calls have no .catch and no loading state, so the page paints 0.00 / 0.00 / 0.00 balances and empty tables until data arrives (I captured 'الرصيد المتاح 0.00' for a user who actually had 7,520) and would keep showing 0.00 silently if a request failed — dangerously misleading on a money screen. Add a skeleton/loading flag and error toast.
Carried over: search only fires on Enter (no debounce, no search button).

issues: Content is 100% B2B: hero reads 'سوق B2B لتبادل بكجات العمرة والسياحة' / 'اربط مكتبك بشبكة المكاتب' and grep of Landing.js finds ZERO occurrences of فرد/مستهلك/مسوّق/عمولة — yet registration offers 'فردي (مستهلك/مسوّق)' and the affiliate link (/?ref=CODE) lands consumers exactly here. Individuals arriving from a marketer link see no consumer or affiliate value proposition.
No mention of the marketer/affiliate program (the ?ref= code IS captured correctly to localStorage, but nothing on the page explains it).
Metrics present and correct, but labels are 'الأفراد'/'المسوّقون' while the spec says 'عدد الأفراد' — cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: market.py _view_package correctly strips net_cost_per_seat and buyer_office_commission for guests and individuals on BOTH /packages and /packages/{id} — verified via API and UI; only /packages/mine (office-only) returns raw docs.

B2C booking math is exactly per spec: charged = final_sale_price*seats, seller pending = net, platform_profit = margin - marketer_commission, marketer = 20% of margin; validated per-booking against the platform_revenue collection instead of the global total (the global admin total is not parallel-test-safe).

B2C blue cancellation reverses the margin correctly (platform_revenue nets to 0 for the booking, marketer commission clawed back) — money is not created; the only defect is the missing overdraft guard and the missing ledger entry.

individual.py require_individual / security.require_buyer / require_office role gates are consistently applied: an individual gets 403 on /packages (create), /packages/mine, /bookings/{id}/issue-visas|dispatch|settle and /admin/*; an office gets 403 on /individual/*.

rca_of_the_issue: Negative marketer wallet: market.py create_booking credits the affiliate commission straight into wallet.available (adjust_wallet(marketer, available=+c, total=+c)) at booking time, i.e. before the trip is delivered, so it is immediately usable for a new booking. cancel_request (blue branch) reverses it with an unconditional $inc of -c and no balance/clamp check, so if the marketer already spent the money the $inc drives available/total below zero (observed -58: 60 credited, 58 spent on a cheap package which itself returned 2 of self-referral commission, then -60 reversal). Because the reversal is also not written to the transactions collection, the resulting wallet cannot be reconciled from the ledger (user1: wallet 8,740 vs ledger 8,800). Mitigation: escrow the commission in wallet.pending until the booking reaches green+settled, then move to available; and always emit a txn row for every wallet mutation.
